title: Attach a file to a chat message
description: One file the person is attaching: its name as their system gives it (sanitised before it is used), its media type (`''` when the browser doesn't know it) and its bytes as base64.

name.description: The file's name; the server keeps letters, digits, `.`, `-` and `_`, and never trusts the rest.

type.description: The file's media type, as the browser reports it; `''` when unknown. Any type is taken.

data.description: The file's bytes as standard base64, padded; at most 10 MB once decoded.
